description: Look up indicative material properties for a common metal or plastic by designation, such as 6061-T6, 304 or Ti-6Al-4V. Returns density, yield and ultimate strength, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, elongation, thermal expansion and maximum service temperature, all in SI. These are TYPICAL handbook values, not design allowables: every value is tagged basis: typical. Use them to compare materials, estimate mass, or supply an indicative modulus to an analysis; obtain an allowable from a qualified source before relying on a strength margin. An unmatched designation means this reference does not hold it, not that the material does not exist.

property.description: Restrict the answer to one property, so the response stays small.
